This is my Week9 update - https://hackmd.io/@groverInnovate/H1o6foWvze
I worked on initially auditing the Ream's signing path, then revising my original approach for the design of test driver operation and came up with a more robust approach and I have shared the Proposed API contract and opened a Issue on Ream as it required some refactoring to extract the ProposalSigner Operation from the ValidatorService

I've tried a different writing style as compared to my usual one as it's more Elaborate and tells about the step by step thought process throughout the week, so hope you like this writing style

I'm Open to any feedback;
